$comment: SHARED CONTRACT FIXTURE — byte-identical copies live in two repositories:
Each repository has a test that asserts ITS OWN implementation matches this
file, so vocabulary drift fails that repository's CI. Neither repo can see
the other at build time; the fixture is the shared written-down answer, and
`fixture_sha256` lets a reviewer confirm the two copies are the same bytes.
If you change this file, change it in both repositories in the same change.
introduced_by: PR 7.12 — remove the Stargaze wallet-address fan-out

items.note: Unchanged, field for field. An older frontend keeps working.

holdings_status.absent_means: an older backend during deployment — a deployment fact, not a state
holdings_status.null_is_forbidden_because: null previously meant several different things at once; that ambiguity is the defect this field exists to remove

meanings.complete: every required holdings source completed successfully; an empty items array is trustworthy
meanings.partial: some positive evidence may be available, but at least one required source was incomplete; absence is not proof
meanings.unavailable: no trustworthy holdings determination could be completed

rules: only complete + items=[] may mean the user has no detected verified collections
partial + items=[] must not be interpreted as zero holdings
unavailable + items=[] must not be interpreted as zero holdings
positive items must still be returned and displayed when the overall result is partial
an unavailable Cosmos lookup must not erase EVM or Solana results

frontend_copy.complete_without_items: No verified collections were detected in your linked wallets.
frontend_copy.partial_with_items: render the known collections plus a notice: Some linked wallets could not be fully checked.
frontend_copy.partial_without_items: We couldn’t finish checking all of your linked wallets. Try again later.
frontend_copy.unavailable: Collection holdings are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
frontend_copy.absent: legacy behaviour, retained only for deployment compatibility
forbidden: showing “No collections detected” for partial or unavailable
exposing wallet addresses, provider names, request errors or internal status tokens

unchanged_elsewhere.set_stance_unavailable: POST /bcc/v1/me/collection-stances still answers bcc_unavailable with HTTP 503 when holdings cannot be verified; it must NOT become a 200 body field, which the frontend would render as success

fixture_sha256_note: sha256 of the canonical vocabulary array, computed over the exact string: complete,partial,unavailable
